original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')

# Pilot eval + status logging
from pilot.pilot_eval_template import run_pilot_eval
from pilot.log_status import append_status

# Optional deterministic seed
try:
    from utilities.seed_tools import seed_from_str, set_seed, make_rng
    base_seed = seed_from_str("pilot-P1-Axiom-I")
    set_seed(base_seed); _, _ = make_rng(base_seed)
except Exception:
    pass

# Run tiny eval artifact
artifact_path = run_pilot_eval(agent="Axiom I")

# Append eval status (Tick 36)
append_status({"agent":"Axiom I","join":35,"eval":36,"announce":None,"mail":None,"notes":"P1 eval complete; artifact written."})

print("Pilot eval done:", artifact_path)
print("Status appended for eval tick 36.")
